The total sum modulo 9 is invariant. Initially,
\[
1+2+\cdots+2013 \equiv 3 \pmod 9.
\]
The possible final quadruples with product \(27\) are:
\[
(1,1,1,27),\ (1,1,3,9),\ (1,3,3,3).
\]
Their sums are \(30,14,10\), which are congruent to \(3,5,1\pmod 9\), respectively. Only \(30\equiv 3\pmod 9\) matches.

Thus the sum of the four numbers is \(\boxed{30}\).
